scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/data.test.ts src/matrix-data.test.ts src/matrix-contrast.test.ts src/matrix-display.test.ts src/font-ready.test.ts src/matrix-scroll.test.ts src/matrix-selection.test.ts src/production-data.test.ts src/snapshot-loader.test.ts src/snapshot-selection.test.ts
